subject: Maths
title: Percentage of an amount
subtitle: Percentages · GCSE Maths
learning_objective: I can calculate a percentage of an amount using mental and written methods.

key_vocab.term: Finding a percentage of an amount
key_vocab.definition: To find a percentage of an amount, divide by 100 to find 1%, then multiply by the percentage needed. Or use the multiplier method.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can calculate a percentage of an amount using mental and written methods.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: Finding a percentage of an amount -- To find a percentage of an amount, divide by 100 to find 1%, then multiply by the percentage needed. Or use the multiplier method.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Percentage means per hundred. Divide by 100 to find 1%, then scale up.
P% of A = &frac{P}{100} × A
Convert percentage to decimal, then multiply

Key examples:
  ✓ 10% of 70 = 7  (divide by 10)
  ✓ 25% of 60 = 15  (divide by 4)
  ✓ 15% of 80 = 12  (10% + 5% = 8 + 4)
  ✗ 10% of 70 = 70  (that is 100%)
  ✗ 25% of 60 = 20  (divided by 3 not 4)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – using 10%
  Find 30% of 90
  10% of 90 = 9
  30% = 3 × 10%
  3 × 9 = 27
  = 27
  (Find 10% first, then multiply by 3 for 30%.)

Example 2 – using the multiplier
  Find 45% of 200
  45% as a decimal = 0.45
  0.45 × 200
  = 90
  = 90
  (The multiplier method works for any percentage.)

sections.title: Common percentages
sections.content:
Use mental methods to find each percentage.

(a) 50% of 84
(b) 25% of 120
(c) 10% of 65
(d) 75% of 200

sections.title: Multiples of 10%
sections.content:
Find 10% first, then use it.

(a) 20% of 150
(b) 40% of 85
(c) 60% of 45
(d) 90% of 70

sections.title: Using the multiplier
sections.content:
Use the decimal multiplier to calculate.

(a) 35% of 80
(b) 12% of 250
(c) 85% of 60
(d) 4% of 350

sections.title: Percentage of money
sections.content:
Find each percentage amount.

(a) 15% of £80
(b) 8% of £450
(c) 17.5% of £200
(d) 33% of £600

sections.title: Mixed percentage problems
sections.content:
Calculate each percentage.

(a) 5% of 320
(b) 72% of 50
(c) 2.5% of 400
(d) 65% of £180
(e) 11% of 900

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ 10% of 45 = 4.5
✗ 10% means divide by 100
✓ 35% of 80 = 0.35 × 80 = 28
✗ 25% of 60 = 60 ÷ 25 = 2.4
✓ To find 1%, divide the amount by 100
